# Motion › Spin

**What belongs here.** Rotation in the picture plane.

**Examples.** spin, roll

**Family test.** Do the pixels keep their shape while they move?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Spin](spin/) | A shape in the new background colour spins in at the centre and grows while the camera rolls with it, until it fills the frame; the new scene then spins into place. |
